effect: When the requested prose is the reply itself, it is delivered without preface, recap or receipt.

semantic.criterion: The reply begins with the notice itself: no sentence introducing it, no heading about the task, and no comment before the notice text.
The reply ends with the notice itself: nothing after it about what was done, what it covers, where it could be saved, or what else could be done.
Every point on the notice comes from notes/spray-booth.md, and the glaze monitor remains the one who changes the filter.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
